Name: I Caught This Continued
Author: Fen1kks
Description:
[b]Description[/b]
I Caught This Continued credits fish to your Fish Collection when they enter your inventory, without interfering with normal vanilla fishing.
This is useful for fish obtained through shops, gifts, chests, crab pots, other mods, or any non-standard source where Stardew Valley may not automatically mark them as caught.

[b]Installation Instructions[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Download this mod.[/*]
[*]Unzip the mod folder into your Stardew Valley `Mods` folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]Optional: Install Generic Mod Config Menu if you want to change the trigger mode or manual keybind in-game.

Main Features
[list]
[*]Automatically credits uncaught fish when they enter your inventory.[/*]
[*]Manual mode available with a configurable keybind.[/*]
[*]Default manual key: [b]F9[/b].[/*]
[*]Does not add items, duplicate fish, or interfere with vanilla fishing.[/*]
[*]Skips non-fish items, trash, and Joja Cola.[/*]
[*]Supports English and Turkish translations.[/*]
[*]Optional Generic Mod Config Menu support.[/*]
[/list]Requirements
[list]
[*]SMAPI 4.0.0 or newer.[/*]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6 or newer.[/*]
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu is optional, not required.[/*]
[/list][b]Shout Outs[/b]
This is a continued version of the original [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27632]I Caught This[/url] mod by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/emurphy42]John Peters (you know, the farmer?)[/url], updated for newer SMAPI/Stardew Valley versions with additional configuration and localization support.
